answer_1.quote: Data-to-text (D2T) generation is the process of converting structured data, like meaning representations or knowledge graphs, into coherent and fluent natural language text.
answer_1.outputs: coherent and fluent natural language text

answer_3.quote: In addition to human annotation, we also applied an LLM-as-judge approach, using GPT o3 (Ope-nAI, 2025b), Claude Sonnet 3.7 by Anthropic (Anthropic, 2024), and Gemini 2.5 Pro to assess outputs according to the same criteria, as described in .

answer_4.quote: Three co-authors served as annotators for the human evaluation. The assessment was conducted in a blind fashion, with annotators unaware of the source system for each output.
answer_4.guideline: Outputs were evaluated on a 7-point Likert scale (1 -lowest, 7 -highest) using four criteria (as shown in Table and ): fluency, grammaticality, no-omission, and no-addition, following the human assessment protocol established in .
